commits.subject: Make Guardian V3 routing and retrieval guidance configurable (#62372)
commits.reason: Carry configurable Guardian guidance under the upstream feature settings. Keep the repository-level trust boundary and existing ALab defaults.
evidence: The project config loader strips routing and retrieval instructions and their token cap. Prompt settings alone do not enable Guardian.
The sampler accounts for custom guidance and schema size, chooses a prefix of complete evidence items, and leaves the cursor in place when the first record cannot fit.
The fork changes packaged defaults and profile loading in this loader. Those hooks are separate from the project guidance filter.
commits.revisit: Run prompt filtering and limit tests, bounded routing and the packaged policy checks after integration.

commits.subject: Add opt-in in-memory message boards for Guardian v3 (#62373)
commits.reason: Keep file-backed Guardian boards as the default. Carry the isolated in-memory board for fresh or cleared roots when explicitly configured.
evidence: The writer and restricted reviewer share a SQLite pool. A new root receives its own board and the last closed handle releases it.
The host checks history initialization before opening a memory board. A cold-resumed root cannot recover evidence from a prior in-memory board.
The restriction concerns attached Guardian review. It leaves ordinary conversation resume, model promotion and persisted thread history available.
commits.revisit: Exercise the upstream file and memory catch-up cases and cold resume before release.

commits.subject: Reconsider denials in attached Guardian reviews (#62374)
commits.reason: Apply the existing opt-in denial reconsideration policy consistently to attached and standalone Guardian reviews.
evidence: The shared verdict runner installs DenialResample only when the feature is enabled and removes it when the attempt finishes.
The attached path drains the interrupted sample at its deadline. Its first denial and rationale can survive the timeout. Cancellation and authority invalidation still have dedicated checks.
The app-server integration case covers identical resampling input, the second verdict and the timed-out retry on an actual pending MCP action.
commits.revisit: Run the app-server pending MCP review matrix and verify an interrupted second sample keeps the original denial.
